steps.title: Validate Project Configuration
steps.description: Establish target SDK compile version 34, set Java 8 language compatibility, and configure standard package structure.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Formulate AndroidManifest.xml with correct namespace, configure launcher activity, set hardware acceleration, and define resource icons.

steps.title: Configure Build System Gradle File
steps.description: Construct build.gradle compatible with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5 with dependency exclusion rules.

steps.title: Define Color Archetypes
steps.description: Establish the mystical theme color palette in colors.xml utilizing midnight purple, celestial gold, and psychic neon magenta.

steps.title: Establish Text Resource Properties
steps.description: Draft translations, dialog prompts, 20 custom responses for Magic 8-Ball, and the step-by-step mind reader sequence in strings.xml.

steps.title: Generate Mystic Graphic Drawables
steps.description: Draw custom XML shapes for the mystical crystal ball background, glowing tab selectors, rounded magic cards, and interactive buttons.

steps.title: Construct Interactive App Layout
steps.description: Build dynamic user interface activity_main.xml comprising simulated tabs, interactive elements, text configurations, and full-bleed animation canvas.

steps.title: Implement High-Performance Canvas Particle Engine
steps.description: Develop MagicParticleView.java to run high-performance particle physics, custom rendering, and dynamic gravity effects when casting magic.

steps.title: Develop Magic 8-Ball Core Logic
steps.description: Program full randomized answers with animated shake motions and interactive virtual questionnaire submission handling.

steps.title: Design Mathematical Mind Reading Mechanism
steps.description: Build interactive card trick game in MainActivity that steps the user through cosmic calculations leading to the inevitable psychic reveal.

steps.title: Integrate Physical Accelerometer Sensors & Audio Feedback
steps.description: Bind hardware acceleration listener to detect physical device waving/shaking, and generate high-pitch chiptune spells via ToneGenerator.

steps.title: Building Magic Wand & Oracle
steps.description: Execute gradle compilation, verify integrity of XML assets, assemble, and optimize debug package output.
